```{r setup_engine, include=FALSE}
knitr::knit_engines$set(listeng = function(options) {
  out <- list(
    structure(list(src = "listeng source"), class = "source"),
    "listeng stdout text"
  )
  knitr::engine_output(options, out = out)
})
```
